integrity: The asymptotic statement follows from an all-size symbolic and Fourier proof. Finite exact checks corroborate boundary cases but are not an infinite proof; independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the grand-coalition partition on the unweighted symmetric cycle is studied; no minimization over partitions is claimed.
The result uses strictly improving deviations by all members and uniform subset sampling, not weak blocking or weighted/directed games.
Known cyclic-run enumeration methods may have independent prior formulations; unindexed probabilistic-core results remain a priority risk.
title: Exact rare-blocking law for the grand coalition in cyclic fractional hedonic games
